title: Read a small request body
responsibility: Read a request stream with a 20000-byte limit.

inputs.name: hubBodyBytes.request
inputs.description: The Fetch Request whose body stream the function consumes. A body is required; a missing body causes an invalid-input rejection.

outputs.name: hubBodyBytes
outputs.description: A Uint8Array containing all body-stream chunks concatenated in order. The promise resolves empty for an empty stream; it accepts up to 20,000 bytes and, after reading a chunk that takes the total over that limit, cancels the reader and rejects with invalid-input.

errors.name: invalid-input
errors.description: The function rejects when the request has no body reader or the accumulated chunk length exceeds 20,000 bytes. The oversized path cancels the reader before rejecting.
